mainEntity.name: How much does a BMW 4 Series 418d engine replacement cost in the UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: A BMW 4 Series 418d engine replacement typically costs between £3,200 and £5,500 for a reconditioned unit, with rebuilt engines ranging from £3,800 to £5,800 for the B47D20A and £4,500 to £6,500 for the N47D20U1. Used engines start from around £1,800. These prices are supply-only - fitting adds 8-12 hours of labour at specialist rates (£520-£780).

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of timing chain failure in a BMW 4 Series 418d?

acceptedAnswer.text: The N47D20U1 engine fitted to early BMW 4 Series 418d models (2014-2015) is known for timing chain issues. The most common early warning is a metallic rattling noise on cold start that wasn't there before, or a rattle at idle that changes when you touch the accelerator. If the chain snaps, valves collide with pistons - engine is destroyed. B47D20A engines (2015-onwards) have a front-mounted chain and are far less prone to this issue.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a BMW 4 Series 418d?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on your car's value and condition. For a 2014-2017 BMW 4 Series 418d worth £4,000-£10,000, a rebuilt engine at £3,200-£5,500 is a significant investment but often worthwhile if the car is otherwise in good condition. For cars under £5,000, carefully evaluate whether a used engine or repair makes more financial sense.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between the BMW 4 Series 418d and 420d engines?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both the 418d and 420d use 2.0-litre turbo-diesel engines, but the 420d is tuned for higher output. The 418d produces 143-150bhp, while the 420d produces approximately 181-190bhp. The engines share the same basic architecture - N47 in early cars, B47 in later models - but the 420d features a different turbocharger and engine calibration.

mainEntity.name: How long does a BMW 4 Series 418d engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A BMW 4 Series 418d engine replacement typically takes 2-3 days for a specialist workshop to complete, assuming the replacement engine is already in stock. This includes removal of the old engine, fitting the replacement, and full system testing. Supply only: 1-2 days for delivery. Supply & fit: 2-3 days in the workshop.

mainEntity.name: Can I replace my N47 engine with a B47 in my BMW 4 Series 418d?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes - a B47D20A engine from a 2015-onwards BMW 4 Series 418d is a direct physical fit for earlier N47D20U1 cars. The B47 offers significantly better reliability thanks to its front-mounted timing chain design. However, you'll need to ensure the engine management software is correctly calibrated for the newer engine.

mainEntity.name: What warranty comes with a BMW 4 Series 418d replacement engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every rebuilt and reconditioned engine supplied through EnginesMarket carries a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty. Some suppliers offer extended warranties of up to 24 months on certain engine types. Always confirm exact terms with your chosen supplier before purchase.

historyTimeline.h2: BMW 4 Series 418d - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: The BMW 4 Series 418d arrived in 2014 as the entry-level diesel in the 4 Series range, positioned below the 420d. It was offered across all three body styles - Coupe (F32), Convertible (F33) and Gran Coupe (F36) - and underwent a significant engine upgrade from the N47 to the more reliable B47 family during its production run.

milestones.description: B47D20A introduced, 2.0-litre turbo-diesel, 147-150bhp / 110kW, Euro 6 emissions compliant
Gran Coupe production concludes for the 418d
4 Series Coupe and Convertible 418d production ends
Second-generation G22 4 Series launched; the 418d badge was discontinued in favour of the 418i petrol entry model

commonProblems.h2: BMW 4 Series 418d Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The BMW 4 Series 418d was offered with two engine generations - the early N47D20U1 (2014-2015) and the later B47D20A (2015-2020). The N47 is known for timing chain issues that can be catastrophic, while the B47 is significantly more reliable but has its own EGR and emissions-related concerns. Rebuilt engines through EnginesMarket include upgraded components addressing the original failure points, plus a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: N47 Timing Chain Failure - Why the BMW 4 Series 418d N47D20U1 Wears Prematurely
problems.rootCause: The timing chain is located at the rear of the engine bay and was not designed as a serviceable part. Over time, the chain stretches and the tensioner fails, leading to a metallic rattle on cold start. If ignored, the chain can snap, causing valves to collide with pistons and destroying the engine.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace chain, tensioner and guides - engine remains in car
repairOptions.longevity: If caught early before damage occurs; extends engine life significantly

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, upgraded components addressing the original failure point, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: If engine has already suffered internal damage; peace of mind with warranty

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical BMW 4 Series 418d of 2014-2017 vintage sits in the £4,000-£12,000 value band `[THIRD-PARTY, AutoTrader/Parkers]`. For cars valued under £6,000, a timing chain repair (if caught early) is almost always the better financial decision. For cars valued £6,000-£10,000, a reconditioned engine replacement is viable if you plan to keep the car 2+ years. For cars valued £10,000+, a rebuilt engine with warranty often represents good value relative to the car's worth. If an N47-equipped 418d has suffered a snapped timing chain and the car is worth under £5,000, evaluate scrap value before committing to a full replacement.
problems.recommendation: For N47D20U1-engined BMW 4 Series 418d models, preventative timing chain replacement at 60,000-80,000 miles is the smartest financial move - it's far cheaper than a full engine replacement. If you're already hearing cold-start rattle, have it inspected immediately. If the engine has already failed catastrophically, a reconditioned or rebuilt B47D20A engine (from a 2015-onwards car) is the recommended replacement, as it addresses the timing chain design flaw and offers significantly better long-term reliability.

problems.h4: B47 EGR Cooler Failure - Emissions System Weak Point
problems.rootCause: The EGR cooler can develop internal leaks, allowing coolant to enter the exhaust system. This can lead to reduced performance, warning lights, and in some cases, a fire risk. BMW issued a recall for this issue on many B47-equipped models.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace EGR cooler and associated gaskets; system flush
repairOptions.longevity: If caught early; restores emissions compliance and performance

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, includes updated EGR components, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: If EGR failure has caused secondary damage; peace of mind with warranty

EGR cooler replacement is a straightforward repair that makes financial sense on almost any example. Full engine replacement is rarely required for EGR failure alone - only consider it if the engine has sustained additional damage.
problems.recommendation: The EGR cooler issue on the B47D20A is well-understood and relatively inexpensive to fix compared to the N47's timing chain problem. If your BMW 4 Series 418d displays a warning light or loss of power, have the EGR system inspected promptly. Replacement of the cooler is almost always the right call - it's a fraction of the cost of a full engine replacement and resolves the issue permanently with updated components.
